page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable instruction blocks. Attach them to any agent — order decides where they land in the prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a block of instructions an agent reads before it reviews. Write one, or import a markdown file or archive.

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: Plain text an agent reads before it reviews. It cannot run anything.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag branches of a changed function that no test reaches.
create.bodyPlaceholder:
# Uncovered branch gate

For each function changed in the diff…

listItem.vettingTitle: Imported from outside — read it before you enable it
listItem.agentCount: {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

preview.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Any agent using it loses it. This cannot be undone.
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from outside. An enabled skill is read as instructions inside your agent's prompt — read the body before you enable it.
preview.descriptionHint: Write it as an instruction, not a summary — "Flag tests that mock the unit under test", not "about mocking". This is the skill's interface.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new version.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: A markdown file, or a .zip whose markdown core we extract.
import.pickHint: Up to 2 MB. Nothing is stored until you confirm.
import.tooLarge: That file is over the 2 MB limit.
import.previewHint: Check it, edit the fields if you like, then confirm. Nothing has been saved yet.
import.success: Imported "{name}". It is disabled until you enable it.
import.bodyReadOnly: Shown as extracted. It is stored exactly as it is here — the server re-checks its hash on confirm.

errors.no_skill_core: No markdown file in that archive — there is nothing to use as the skill body.
errors.unsupported_archive: That file is not a .zip archive we can read.
errors.unsafe_entry_path: That archive contains a file path that escapes the archive. Nothing was imported.
errors.archive_too_large: That archive is too large — the limit is 2 MB, and 256 KB per file.
errors.import_changed: The file changed since the preview. Pick it again.

versions.hint: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible.
versions.diffLabel: Show what changed between v{version} and the current body
versions.diffIsCurrent: This is the current body — nothing to compare.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore the body from v{version}? It is saved as a new version, v{next} — nothing in the history is overwritten.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.body: This cannot be undone. {count, plural, =0 {No agent currently sends this skill} one {# agent currently sends this skill and will lose it from its prompt} other {# agents currently send this skill and will lose it from their prompt}}.
delete.label: Delete “{name}”
